seed: The user, 2026-09-25: 'when the video or image is centered, we should try to center above the toolbar so its not covered up.' At Next defaults with no flag set, a tall portrait picture, a wide picture and a recording are each fitted (on open, with Cmd-0, and again when the window gets smaller) and every time the whole picture ends above the floating tool bar. Zoomed in by hand, the camera is left alone.

steps.note: a tall portrait picture opened the way the Finder opens one: the window sized to it, the whole picture above the bar
THE TEST: Cmd-0 fits the tall picture into the canvas above the bar, so its bottom edge is not under it
the window got smaller while the picture was fitted: it keeps fitting, still above the bar
a wide picture fitted with Cmd-0 sits centred in the canvas above the bar
THE TEST: a recording opens to watch, fitted above the bar, which floats over the canvas just above the transport
the tracks came up under the canvas and the recording refitted into the shorter canvas, still clear of the bar
a smaller window: the recording still fits above the bar
zoomed in by hand: the picture is bigger than the canvas and may run under the bar, on purpose
